paragraphs: On 15 August 2020, in the Benjarong Room, Wiang Lakhon Hotel, Lampang Province, Dr. Duangta Tancho, Secretary-General of the Office of the Royal Society, chaired the judging of the final round of the storytelling contest on “Local Wisdom: Food, Toys and Everyday Objects”, Group 2, Northern Region. The judging committee, contestants and the coaching teachers of students who passed the first round took part in the activity

The contest results are as follows. First prize: Miss Chiratchaya Sariya, Ban Mai School, Lampang Province, received a scholarship of 12,000 baht and a certificate. First runner-up: Miss Samita Ngamthae, Ban Sop Phlueng School, Lampang Province, received a scholarship of 10,000 baht and a certificate of honor. Second runner-up: Master Noppakao Khapphap, Ban Thung Tam School, Lampang Province, received a scholarship of 8,000 baht and a certificate of honor.

Honorable mentions: Miss Kirana Li, Kirana Homeschool, Chiang Mai Province; Miss Kumphaphak Khatsutha, Ban Tin Pet School, Chiang Rai Province; Master Chanawin Inkhamchuea, Ban Pong Sanuk School, Lampang Province; Miss Netnapha Yaemthat, Ban Mae Ang School, Lampang Province; Miss Priyaphat Saensuk, Ban Rai School, Chiang Mai Province; Master Phirawat Chanthra, Kowit Thamrong Chiang Mai School, Chiang Mai Province; Miss Fasai Chanthama, San Pa Tong (Suwannarat Withayakhan) School, Chiang Mai Province. Students receiving honorable mentions each receive a scholarship of 3,000 baht and a certificate of honor.
